title: Three City contracts funded a $280,540 Jin Electric wage settlement

beats.text: Jin Construction won a separate San Francisco traffic signal contract.

visual.sub: A separate traffic-signal award establishes the contractor’s bidding history

beats.text: The award was $662,485. It came before the wage lawsuit.

visual.label: A separate traffic-signal award establishes the contractor’s bidding history

beats.text: Six plaintiffs brought their federal case in June 2003.

visual.kicker: A federal wage case names the employer and the public owners

beats.text: City labor investigators assessed prevailing wage violations against Jin.

visual.kicker: A federal wage case names the employer and the public owners

beats.text: Three other public works contracts held the money for the partial settlement.

visual.kicker: Three retained contract balances fund the partial settlement

beats.text: The largest amount came from the Conservatory of Flowers.
The second came from the Laguna Honda fire alarm project.
The third came from the Pier 43 arch repair.

visual.label: Three retained contract balances fund the partial settlement

beats.text: The federal court recorded a voluntary dismissal in October 2004.

visual.kicker: The federal court recorded a voluntary dismissal

beats.text: Code 12 records how the case ended. A payment ledger would show what workers received.

visual.kicker: The federal court recorded a voluntary dismissal
